prompt: A hyper-realistic, cinematic horror scene featuring a massive werewolf crouching atop the rusted remains of an abandoned merry-go-round in a desolate playground. The creature is covered in matted dark fur and tattered rags, with glowing orange eyes and sharp teeth bared in a ferocious snarl. Its claws grip the metal bars tightly. To the left, a rusty swing set hangs empty; to the right, a weathered wooden sign reads "PLAYGROUND RULES: HAVE FUN BE SAFE SHARE SMILE". In the background, a dilapidated gazebo stands among bare trees under a stormy night sky illuminated by a full moon and jagged lightning bolts. Heavy rain falls throughout the scene, creating wet reflections on the ground and enhancing the ominous atmosphere.

promptZh: 一个超写实的电影级恐怖场景：一只巨大的狼人蹲伏在一座荒废游乐场里生锈旋转木马的残骸上。这只生物浑身覆盖着纠结的黑色毛发和破烂不堪的衣物，橙色的眼睛闪烁着光芒，龇牙咧嘴地发出凶猛的咆哮。它的爪子紧紧抓住金属栏杆。左侧，一套锈迹斑斑的秋千架空荡荡地悬挂着；右侧，一块风化严重的木牌上写着“PLAYGROUND RULES: HAVE FUN BE SAFE SHARE SMILE”。背景中，一座破旧的凉亭矗立在光秃秃的树木之间，暴风雨般的夜空被满月和锯齿状的闪电照亮。大雨倾盆而下，在地面上形成湿滑的反光，增强了不祥的氛围。
